name: playwright-ts-automation
description: BDD UI automation framework - playwright-bdd + @playwright/test + TypeScript. POC target: OrangeHRM Admin module.

scripts.test: bddgen test --tags "not @wip and not @bug" && playwright test
scripts.test:smoke: bddgen test --tags "@smoke and not @wip and not @bug" && playwright test
scripts.test:regression: bddgen test --tags "not @smoke and not @wip and not @bug" && playwright test
scripts.test:login: bddgen test --tags "@login and not @wip and not @bug" && playwright test
scripts.test:userManagement: bddgen test --tags "@userManagement and not @wip and not @bug" && playwright test
scripts.test:jobTitles: bddgen test --tags "@jobTitles and not @wip and not @bug" && playwright test
scripts.test:headed: bddgen test --tags "not @wip and not @bug" && playwright test --headed
